label: Invasion of the north coast
summary: British forts built on Tiwi and Iwaidja Country; all abandoned in the face of resistance and conditions.

label: Frontier war and massacres
summary: South Australia claims the Territory; police and settlers massacre Aboriginal people to clear Country for pastoral runs, mines and the telegraph.

label: Removal and confinement
summary: The Chief Protector is legal guardian of every Aboriginal child and controls Aboriginal women for life; children are stolen into compounds and missions.

label: Forced assimilation
summary: The Welfare Ordinance makes 15,711 Aboriginal Territorians wards of the state; child theft continues.

label: Land rights struggle
summary: Gurindji and other nations force land rights onto the agenda; the Land Rights Act passes in 1976.

label: Territory settler rule
summary: The NT Government takes control of police, prisons and child protection; Aboriginal deaths in custody force a Royal Commission (1991).

label: The Intervention
summary: The Commonwealth suspends the Racial Discrimination Act to impose income management, alcohol bans, compulsory leases, police and the army.

label: Intervention continued
summary: Intervention measures continue under new names; torture of children in Don Dale is exposed (2016).

label: Mass incarceration and removal
summary: Criminal responsibility back to age 10, spit hoods back, the Child Placement Principle weakened, record imprisonment of Aboriginal people.
